note: What a Codex launch needs from outside its own trial tree. The wall is the sandbox for this lane (SB-2): `codex exec` runs with `--sandbox danger-full-access` inside it, because macOS refuses a second seatbelt inside the first. Nothing under `~/.codex` is reachable; the condition's own CODEX_HOME is the only harness home in the profile.
